caption:
Inherent, a London-based AI lab founded by Google DeepMind alumni, announced that its AI agent, Faraday, has outperformed models from Anthropic and OpenAI. Faraday can independently replicate scientific findings, challenging the capabilities of larger models while using significantly fewer parameters.

Could this shift the landscape for AI research?

Sources: TechCrunch
